name: system_ch585
description: CH585 clock, protected-access, watchdog, and pin-function registers used during startup and peripheral enable.

sources.reference: WCH CH585DS1 V1.6 system-control register definitions
WCH CH585 public startup, clock, and peripheral examples
CH585M cold-start, HSE/PLL, GPIO, USBFS, and USBHS observations
sources.note: Applies to the recorded CH585M EVT fixture and exact startup images.

registers.name: CLK_SYS_CFG
registers.description: System clock source and PLL divider configuration.

registers.name: HFCK_PWR_CTRL
registers.description: High-frequency RC, crystal, and PLL power control.

fields.name: XT32M_POWER
fields.description: Power the external 32 MHz crystal oscillator.

registers.name: SAFE_MODE_CTRL
registers.description: Protected-write timing control. Bit 0 enables the short automatic safe-access timeout.

fields.name: AUTO_TIMEOUT_ENABLE
fields.description: Enable automatic closure of the protected-write window after approximately sixteen cycles.

registers.name: PIN_CONFIG
registers.description: Analog and digital peripheral pin-function enables.

fields.name: USBFS_PULLUP_ENABLE
fields.description: Enable the USBFS D+ device pull-up.

fields.name: USBFS_ENABLE
fields.description: Enable the USBFS analog pin function.

registers.name: CK32K_CONFIG
registers.description: 32 kHz internal/external oscillator power and selection.

fields.name: XT32K_POWER
fields.description: Power the external 32.768 kHz crystal oscillator.

registers.name: SAFE_ACCESS
registers.description: Protected-register unlock port. Consecutive writes of 0x57 and 0xa8 open the protected window; writing zero closes it.

registers.name: WATCHDOG_COUNT
registers.description: Watchdog count/reload register used to prevent inherited boot state from expiring during oscillator startup.

registers.name: MISC_CTRL
registers.description: Miscellaneous SoC startup controls used by the CH585 initialization sequence.

registers.name: XT32M_TUNE
registers.description: External 32 MHz oscillator tuning used before clock handoff.
